questions.cardDe: Albanien hat die längste Nationalhymne der Welt. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Welches Land hat die Nationalhymne mit dem längsten Text der Welt?
questions.en: Which country has the national anthem with the longest text in the world?

timeline.labelEn: Dionysios Solomos writes the Hymn to Liberty, 158 stanzas, later Greece's national anthem (1823)
timeline.labelDe: Dionysios Solomos schreibt die „Hymne an die Freiheit“ mit 158 Strophen, später Griechenlands Nationalhymne (1823)

source.title: Which Country Has the Longest National Anthem? – WorldAtlas

questions.notes: Card's claim (Albania) is false. Greece's Hymn to Liberty (158 stanzas; only the first two are sung, also Cyprus's anthem) is the longest by text; by playing time Uruguay's anthem is the longest.
